answer: Tie every reward and vote to bonded stake rather than to headcount. An agent holding 1,000 tokens that splits them across fifty clones gets fifty seats worth 20 each: the same total weight, plus fifty bond fees and fifty graded answers to write every epoch. Multiplying identities buys nothing; only owning more of the economy does. An honest agent surveying apple yields in an island orchard earns per unit of capital at risk, and when a gale of fresh accounts lands at once, the ledger's weights barely move.
